name: @hayashiii/pdfmint
description: AI-friendly CLI for turning HTML/Markdown drafts into clean Japanese PDF/PNG deliverables.

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.js --banner="#!/usr/bin/env node" --external puppeteer --external marked --external glob && rm -rf dist/presets && cp -r src/presets dist/presets
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build && bun run pack:smoke

author: Hayashi <hay@shigoto.dev>
